description: Johnson-Morgan UBV bands plus R and I, in several GCPD realisations: Johnson (1951) and Straizys curves for UBV, Mendoza UBVRI, the ADPS versions, and the Landolt (1983) curves.
facility_description: The General Catalogue of Photometric Data (GCPD, Mermilliod, Hauck & Mermilliod; now hosted at Masaryk University, Brno) compiles stellar photometry in more than 80 photometric systems together with system descriptions and filter transmission curves.
notes: NJM's curves for this instrument were taken from the SVO Filter Profile Service (GCPD group). Band Description values are copied verbatim from SVO VOTables, cited via Wayback Machine captures because svo2.cab.inta-csic.es timed out all session; the SVO acknowledgement already on NJM was not re-verified. Bands without the _ADPS suffix whose SVO ProfileReference is arXiv:1412.1474 are the Mann & von Braun (2015) revisions of the GCPD curves; _ADPS bands are the Asiago Database on Photometric Systems versions (Moro & Munari 2000; Fiorucci & Munari 2003), for which SVO's ProfileReference is the GCPD system page. Licence: GCPD publishes no explicit redistribution licence, only a citation request; classed 'attribution' on that basis. The _Mendoza bands follow GCPD system 08 (Mendoza 1963; curves adapted from ApJ 141, 923, 1965). The _Straizys bands are the Straizys UBV curves listed on GCPD's UBV curve page. The _Landolt bands point (in SVO) to ADPS system 119 (Landolt 1983); the ADPS site was unreachable from here, so no Landolt bibcode is given. SVO Description for B_Landolt names the wrong band ('Johnson U filter in GCPD-Landolt 1983'), so it is omitted. No archived SVO VOTable was available for: R, so those bands carry no per-band fields.
